name: DetuneSawLd
description: Detuned saw lead. X picks a scale degree inside one octave; Y crossfades that note across five octaves between adjacent octaves. Depth is detune. PUMP ducks on each 16th step. Touch gates the voice.

params.name: OCT
params.detail: Five-octave position, crossfade between adjacent octaves

params.name: DETUN
params.detail: Detune / beating of the saw stack

params.name: PUMP
params.detail: Duck depth, synced to each 16th step
